label: Issuer had already investigated and turned the cardholder down; the complaint contests that decision
fix: Kept as a fact (issuer_status), not a rule: on TRAIN a prior denial did not separate outcomes

label: Dispute or fraud claim still open, or only just filed
fix: Kept as a fact (issuer_status), not a rule: on TRAIN, pending investigations went with slightly more relief

label: Too vague to identify the transaction, or silent on what the issuer did
fix: Rubric: short or vague narratives ended in relief less often (checked on TRAIN); detail fact

label: Money already credited, or the issuer already handling the fraud
fix: Kept as a fact (issuer_status), no rule

label: Statement mechanics read as errors (pending authorisations, balance moved to a replacement card)
fix: No change: too few cases to justify a rule

label: Judge missed a specific issuer mistake or procedural failure
fix: Rubric names issuer mistakes as a relief signal; issuer_error fact

label: Company paid a small or arguable claim that the rubric would refuse
fix: Rubric: small disputed amounts ended in relief more often (checked on TRAIN)

label: Judge misread the narrative or invented a rule (for example an exclusion for dental work)
fix: Rubric: use only what the narrative says, no invented rules

label: Dissatisfaction with a service that was delivered
fix: Rubric: service-quality complaints ended in relief less often

label: Main request is not money (remove an account, issue hardship letters)
fix: Kept as a fact (ask), no rule

label: Issuer had turned the cardholder down but paid after the regulator complaint
fix: No change: the mirror image of the largest category, not predictable from the text
